notes.title: Hotfix Patch 5 (1.02)
notes.content:
A faulty event causing the wind tunnels to be larger than intended has been patched.

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports!

tags.bug: A faulty event causing the wind tunnels to be larger than intended has been patched.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 4 (1.01)
notes.content:
The following issues has been resolved;

[list]
[*]Further issues where a failsafe was failing at keeping you "safe".
[*]The ability to crouch was locked for keyboard/Dpad due to an mistyped command.
[*]Added a version tracker on the title screen.
[/list]

Additional note:
Please verify the file's integrity to be sure your game has updated properly, the version number should appear on the lower-right corner of the title screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25652094/23bb708f1c3e5ea12b49c1c16b5e78271641dda5.png[/img]

Thank you for your bug reports and feedback!

tags.bug: [*]Further issues where a failsafe was failing at keeping you "safe".
[*]The ability to crouch was locked for keyboard/Dpad due to an mistyped command.

tags.feature: [*]Added a version tracker on the title screen.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 3
notes.content:
An Issue in the final stage where some falling platforms could fall too quickly and cause a death loop has been resolved.

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports!

tags.bug: An Issue in the final stage where some falling platforms could fall too quickly and cause a death loop has been resolved.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 2
notes.content:
It came to our attention that some debug commands were not properly disabled. This caused players that were using the arrow keys for movement to directly control some NPCs/Enemies.

We have released a patch that fixes this issue.

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports!

tags.bug: It came to our attention that some debug commands were not properly disabled. This caused players that were using the arrow keys for movement to directly control some NPCs/Enemies.

notes.title: Hotfix patch
notes.content:
The following has been resolved;

[list]
[*]Loose Wagon's final boss could be controlled with the arrow keys.
[*]Invisible "block" that could destroy your bullet seemingly for no reason on NG+ during a boss fight.
[*]Some stage-confining collisions were not set right.
[*]Depending on your gamepad, using the joystick for movement could cause you to "lock up" when crouching.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your feedback and bug reports!

tags.bug: [*]Loose Wagon's final boss could be controlled with the arrow keys.
[*]Invisible "block" that could destroy your bullet seemingly for no reason on NG+ during a boss fight.
[*]Some stage-confining collisions were not set right.
[*]Depending on your gamepad, using the joystick for movement could cause you to "lock up" when crouching.

notes.title: Patch// End_All
notes.content:
[h1]Newgame+[/h1]
[b]Challenge the game again but with added encounters and stronger enemies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25652094/67d1c3917580bea13c37daaddce3c6aa9ba2f779.png[/img]

Newgame+ is more than just a higher difficulty level; all main stages feature added enemies and boss encounters, putting you in much bigger danger. Do not let your guard down!

[h3]Important note[/h3]
In order to adapt saves to this patch, you will be presented with the following screen when loading your old game;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25652094/605d9c0422c00f396a0b798a8c90f4d44ccd3a3b.png[/img]

[i]If you haven't cleared the game yet, it is important for you to select "Normal". 
Choosing Newgame+ with a under-geared character is not recommended. [/i]


[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
[b]Along with this patch, we've included new achievements, show off your skills by unlocking all 17![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25652094/5a309b4eda83cf4c6652fa7c43288e05c6218275.png[/img]



[h1]MORE[/h1]
As an added Bonus, we added certain quality of life adjustments which goes as follows;

[list]
[*]Maximum extra lives upped from 3 to 5.
[*]Endless mode becomes unlocked right after completing the staged version.
[*]Various checkpoints added throughout some of the harder parts of the game.
[*]Power shots can be gained by landing normal shots.
[*]Rebalanced some bosses health.
[*]The "Glass Warrior" debuff now increases the damage taken instead or lowering your health to one.
[*]You can now adjust the screen shake in the option menu (None, Minimal, Half, Full).
[*]When starting a new game, you can jump directly into newgame+ (For you crazy people out there).
[*]Optimized some highly demanding effects for a better overall performance.
[*]Various stage/enemy placement adjustments.
[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes. 
[/list]


[b][i]Take up arms, Class-C![/i][/b]

notes.title: Announcement for incoming content patch
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Alpha Version.0 will be receiving a brand new content patch as a celebration for its modest yet encouraging success!

[b]This patch will add a Newgame+ mode featuring stronger enemies, new bosses and phases, Steam Achievements and loads of QoL adjustments.
[/b]
We are currently on the last testing stretches, which includes the implantation of achievements and making sure everything falls into place.

As such, achievements will be visible but not active just yet, detailed patch notes will be given once the update is ready.


[i]Thank you for your continuous support![/i]

tags.feature: This patch will add a Newgame+ mode featuring stronger enemies, new bosses and phases, Steam Achievements and loads of QoL adjustments.
